description:
Google Cloud observability adapters for the Culvert framework. Provides
        CloudTraceObservabilityHook (ObservabilityHook backed by OpenTelemetry
        exporting spans to Cloud Trace via the GCP exporter) and
        CloudMonitoringMetricsHook (StageMetricsHook backed by Cloud
        Monitoring), both registered via java.util.ServiceLoader. Sprint-2
        deliverable (issue #24). Multi-contract module — same shape as the
        bigquery-java pilot which ships three contract impls under one pom.

        NO LineageEmitter IS REGISTERED BY THIS MODULE (sprint-23, Story 1.5;
        removal sanctioned by Story 1.2 AC 3). DataCatalogLineageEmitter is
        still shipped but is deprecated and de-registered, for two reasons:
        (1) its only constructor takes three arguments, so ServiceLoader threw
        ServiceConfigurationError on it — an error AutoConfig swallowed, so the
        runtime silently fell back to NoOpLineageEmitter and the adapter had
        emitted nothing for months; and (2) it writes Data Catalog tags, and
        Data Catalog began its phased shutdown on 2026-06-01. Removing the
        registration is behaviour-identical to the swallowed error and stops
        the module advertising an emitter that never emitted. The replacement
        over the Data Lineage API (datalineage.googleapis.com) is blocked
        offline: google-cloud-datalineage is not present in ~/.m2 and this
        build runs mvn -o.
